typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FCMGMIFeeReconST4NFAcopy_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Type as string,
		STRECID as long,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFCST4NFArd
FFCST4NFArd sink(input(
		Type as string,
		STRECID as long,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Type,
		STRECID,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte),
	partitionFileNames:[($FCMGMIFeeReconST4NFAcopy_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> FCMGMIFeeReconST4NFAcopy
